# Hotel The Taksonz

> Official website for Hotel The Taksonz, a hotel on Grand Trunk Road in Ludhiana, Punjab, India.

## About

Hotel The Taksonz provides accommodation, dining, banquet and meeting facilities in Ludhiana. The property is located on Grand Trunk Road, near Ludhiana Railway Station.

- Website: https://hoteltaksonz.com/
- Address: Grand Trunk Road, Ludhiana, Punjab 141008, India
- Phone: +91 98726 00607
- Booking: https://bookone.io/Hotel-The-Taksonz?bookingEngine=true
